summary: validateApp now throws if owner is missing/empty. Billing (payments), core-shell (platform) and reports (insights, also a validateApp caller) pass owner from their package.json team. Assumptions: shared-contracts lives in the monorepo and is inlined at build time, so no registry release/version bump or dependency update was needed; one PR since all changes land together. Owners hardcoded as literals since the inlined bundles can't read package.json.
